jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity:**

  

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.
* Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.
* Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.
* Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

**Client Experience**

* Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.
* Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.
* Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.
* Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.
* Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.
* Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

**Process Improvement & Enablement**

* Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.
* Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.
* Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.
* Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

In your first year, success means:

* New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.
* The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.
* You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.
* Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

### **What You'll Need:**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.
* A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.
* Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.
* Strong organization. You can manage dozens of rollouts at once without letting quality slip, and you use data to spot and fix problems.
* Clear communication, from presenting to executives to explaining complex workflows to non-technical staff.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing tools, plus hands-on experience with CRM, project management, and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Kustomer).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multifamily real estate experience, whether in onsite or regional property operations (e.g., Community Manager) or at a PropTech vendor, ideally with NMHC Top 50 owners/operators.
* Experience with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, AppFolio, or ResMan.
* Experience with Salesforce Flow or custom intake forms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Communications, or a related field.

**Core Competency Profile**

* **Project Management:** Highly organized with superior attention to detail; capable of managing dozens of simultaneous property rollouts without sacrificing quality.
* **Customer-Centric Leadership:** Empathetic listener and skilled communicator capable of simplifying complex workflows for non-technical property staff.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Able to navigate ambiguity, overcome technical blockers, and build constructive relationships across diverse internal and external stakeholders.

### **What We'll Deliver On:**

  

* Competitive base salary plus performance bonus potential
* Flexible work schedule with eligibility to work remotely
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Unlimited vacation
  

At Fetch, we are always looking for awesome people to join our growing team. If you think you’re the right fit for this position, apply today. We’d love to hear from you!

*Fetch is an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will be considered without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, disabilities, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a **Business / Implementation Analyst** for a prospective VA OSP program, contingent upon contract award. These full-time positions will support standardized organizational assessments, implementation-gap analysis, targeted capacity improvement plans, and a repeatable process for tracking progress from findings to action.

Analysts will review qualitative and quantitative evidence, document workflows and implementation conditions, maintain assessment records, and help develop clear recommendations for government decision-makers. The work involves balancing consistent criteria with the realities of different organizational models and maturity levels.

This role works under the Business / Implementation Analyst Lead and with HCD, public-health, evaluation, and data colleagues. Successful candidates bring structured analysis, thoughtful stakeholder engagement, and clear writing to ambiguous operational challenges.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

* Review organizational program narratives, budgets, service plans, data summaries, policies, and workflow artifacts.
* Conduct or support structured assessment sessions using approved maturity rubrics and evidence expectations.
* Document organizational strengths, implementation gaps, workforce and governance needs, systemic barriers, and information gaps.
* Map current-state processes and identify changes needed to improve clarity, consistency, and operational readiness.
* Draft assessment findings and concise organization-specific capacity improvement plans.
* Define proposed next-state conditions, priority support needs, possible support resources, and expected evidence of progress.
* Track assessment findings, routing recommendations, client decisions, support actions, and reassessment points.
* Coordinate with evaluation and public-health SMEs to contextualize findings and avoid unsupported conclusions.
* Prepare decision briefs, requirements lists, action trackers, working-session notes, and presentation materials.
* Support recurring reassessments and aggregate lessons learned for continuous improvement.
* Apply quality, accessibility, confidentiality, and document-control standards to work products.
* Build and maintain structured evidence matrices that connect each finding to its source, assessment domain, maturity criterion, and proposed follow-up.
* Conduct root-cause analyses of workflow failures, staffing constraints, referral bottlenecks, reporting burden, and other implementation barriers identified during assessment.
* Draft clear support requirements that identify the affected audience, urgency, recommended delivery modality, expected outcome, and evidence of progress.
* Maintain a closed-loop action register that differentiates contractor recommendations from VA assignment, grant-management, and policy decisions.
* Coordinate data, evaluation, and public-health input to confirm that recommendations are feasible, context-sensitive, and supported by available evidence.
* Support peer review and quality-checking of assessment packages, maturity judgments, and improvement plans before leadership submission.
* Prepare complete assessment files with source inventories, documented evidence gaps, preliminary criteria interpretations, reviewer questions, and clearly labeled assumptions.
* Analyze how staffing changes, partner agreements, data practices, service definitions, or financial constraints affect a grantee's ability to sustain proposed operational changes.
* Develop concise capacity improvement plan entries with owners or recommended delivery resources, prerequisites, milestones, verifiable evidence of progress, and reassessment triggers.
* Support collaborative workshops by preparing evidence summaries, facilitating focused process walk-throughs, recording decisions, and distinguishing validated findings from future-state ideas.
* Maintain a prioritized work queue of assigned organizations and follow-up actions, coordinating with HCD, evaluation, and data leads to meet review and reporting milestones.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in business, public administration, operations, health services, social sciences, or related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of relevant business analysis, implementation support, operations analysis, process improvement, or organizational assessment work.
* Experience analyzing documents and stakeholder inputs to develop requirements, workflows, findings, and recommended actions.
* Ability to use a structured rubric, maintain traceable evidence, and produce accurate professional deliverables.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and collaborative tracking tools.
* Ability to manage multiple assigned assessments and stakeholder interactions while meeting deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and ability to work effectively with federal stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
* Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust suitability determination; must meet applicable federal/VA background, security, privacy, training, and system-access requirements.
* Experience eliciting business rules, writing operational requirements, documenting decision criteria, and producing clear current-state and proposed-state process maps.
* Practical analytical skills in Excel, issue and action tracking, workflow mapping, document comparison, and structured written synthesis.
* Ability to identify the difference between implementation barriers, data-quality concerns, support needs, and matters requiring government judgment.
* Demonstrated capability to manage evidence versions, record review comments, and resolve documentation discrepancies under time-sensitive delivery cycles.
* Ability to interpret and compare operational source materials such as budgets, staffing plans, service tables, narratives, standard operating procedures, and performance reports.
* Experience preparing concise decision memoranda and action plans that distinguish the root cause of a problem from symptoms and identify measurable next-state conditions.
* Comfort working within defined governance boundaries, seeking senior or government review where policy, compliance, and grant-management judgments are required.

Desired:

* **Highly desirable:** Prior VA OSP/VHA business analysis, program operations, or improvement support experience.
* **Highly desirable:** Experience with federal grantee support, including onboarding, capacity-gap assessment, support-needs tracking, and follow-up improvement actions.
* Experience with maturity models, improvement plans, Lean process mapping, or requirements elicitation.
* Experience supporting qualitative interviews, consensus workshops, or reassessment cycles.
* Business analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or implementation-management credentials.
* Entry Certificate in Business Analysis (ECBA), Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA), PMI-PBA, or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
* Familiarity with requirements traceability matrices, BPMN or comparable process notation, and organizational capability or maturity models.
* Experience with continuous-improvement work in federal, public-health, grant-recipient, or multisite service-delivery settings.
* Familiarity with requirements repositories, business-process mapping tools, workflow automation concepts, or simple data-validation checks that improve consistency.
* Experience documenting action ownership, deadlines, evidence of closure, and later verification in an organizational continuous-improvement setting.

Target salary range: $96,000 - $145,000

***Disclaimer:***

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

The lead will manage a repeatable process for understanding organizational capacity and implementation conditions, including evidence collection, gap analysis, maturity judgments, prioritization, and reassessment. The work requires careful distinction among issues suitable for technical assistance, program management, data/tool improvements, or government-level decisions.

This position works closely with HCD, evaluation, public-health, data, and project-management personnel. Strong candidates are rigorous analysts who can define workable processes, guide a team of practitioners, and make nuanced organizational findings clear, traceable, and useful.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities

* Lead business and implementation analysis for the assessment-to-action framework, maturity rubric, and assessment operating procedures.
* Translate stakeholder interviews and discovery findings into workflow maps, process models, business requirements, and documented decision rules.
* Develop templates, evidence standards, quality controls, and consistent review practices for initial and recurring organizational assessments.
* Guide analysts in diagnosing staffing, governance, workflow, partnership, data, and implementation gaps from qualitative and quantitative evidence.
* Oversee practical, prioritized capacity improvement plans that connect current conditions to next-state goals and observable evidence of progress.
* Design and sustain a closed-loop process linking findings, routing recommendations, authorized support actions, monitoring, and reassessment.
* Distinguish contractor analysis and recommendations from policy, grant-management, and other decisions reserved for government personnel.

* Partner with data analysts to maintain assessment tracking, case traceability, and cross-portfolio trend summaries.
* Quality-review findings, improvement plans, process documentation, and decision-ready briefs for consistency and accessibility.
* Mentor business analysts and maintain a prioritized analysis backlog linked to the program schedule.
* Build an evidence-to-decision traceability model linking domain findings, root causes, recommended actions, government routing decisions, and reassessment milestones.
* Define practical analyst standard operating procedures for intake, evidence review, conflicting-information resolution, peer review, and release of final assessment findings.
* Lead calibration discussions across assessment teams to improve consistent interpretation of maturity levels while documenting necessary context-specific exceptions.
* Use process modeling, root-cause analysis, stakeholder matrices, and impact/effort prioritization to identify feasible improvements that are distinct from policy decisions.
* Translate recurring gaps into structured capability requirements, recommended support modalities, implementation dependencies, and outcome-oriented acceptance measures.
* Brief leadership on systemic barriers, unresolved evidence limitations, portfolio-wide opportunities, and tradeoffs between implementation readiness and evaluation readiness.
* Lead mapping of assessment domains to source documents, interview evidence, decision rules, expected outcomes, and government-approved maturity-stage transitions.
* Create analyst calibration exercises using representative or de-identified cases, documenting what constitutes sufficient evidence and when conflicting findings require escalation.

* Ability to develop repeatable assessments and trace evidence to findings, recommendations, and evaluation or reassessment checkpoints.
* Proficiency with facilitated stakeholder engagement, process mapping, analytical writing, and Microsoft 365 collaboration tools.
* Strong quality-control discipline and skill in synthesizing ambiguous or conflicting evidence into defensible recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and ability to work effectively with federal stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
* Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust suitability determination; must meet applicable federal/VA background, security, privacy, training, and system-access requirements.
* Advanced ability to elicit, validate, and document business requirements, process models, business rules, decision logic, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Practical fluency with root-cause techniques, BPMN-style workflow mapping, RACI/ownership models, prioritization frameworks, and structured quality reviews.
* Experience coaching analysts, setting review standards, resolving inconsistent assessment conclusions, and producing client-ready decision documentation.
* Proficiency with Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, SharePoint or comparable Microsoft 365 and process-mapping tools in distributed teams.
* Experience developing business analysis standards, analyst playbooks, decision matrices, and review procedures that remain usable across different staff, cohorts, and operational settings.
* Ability to lead structured root-cause and impact analysis while differentiating implementable contractor recommendations from grant-management or policy decisions reserved to government officials.

Desired:

* **Highly desirable:** Experience supporting grantee management through evidence reviews, capacity assessments, grant-recipient improvement plans, and technical-assistance routing recommendations.
* Experience establishing organizational maturity models, readiness assessments, or continuous-improvement programs.
* CBAP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent business/organizational analysis training.
* Experience integrating human-centered design and program evaluation into implementation planning.
* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA), or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.
* Experience applying implementation science, organizational maturity models, service-design outputs, or federal grants operations to business improvement.
* Ability to design quality-control checklists and analyst playbooks that can be sustained across multiple grantee cohorts and staffing transitions.
* Experience facilitating cross-disciplinary adjudication of incomplete or inconsistent findings and documenting defensible decisions with explicit evidence limitations.

We win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. With an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including Georgian, Silver Lake Waterman, Battery, and others) and deep industry experience, Tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. Today, Tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include:

* Named on the 2024 Best and Brightest in the Nation list
BuiltIn’s 2024 Best Place to Work  

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**  
  
We are looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our Field Engineering organization. The Implementation Engineer (IE) is a customer-facing technical partner who works closely with Account Teams and customers to drive successful implementations, accelerate platform adoption, and ensure measurable outcomes across the customer lifecycle.
  
  
This role goes beyond traditional implementation delivery. It requires a blend of technical consulting, solution design, customer data strategy, and data analysis to support complex customer environments. The IE serves as a trusted advisor, helping customers solve technical challenges, optimize their use of the platform, and realize sustained business value through proactive engagement and guidance.
  
  
We’re placing greater emphasis on individuals who can think strategically, operate independently, leverage AI and modern tools effectively, and drive efficient outcomes. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong ownership, resourcefulness, data-driven decision-making, adaptability, continuous learning, and a highly collaborative mindset across internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
This role also requires the ability to effectively leverage AI-powered tools and modern workflows to accelerate implementation delivery, improve data quality and troubleshooting, and enhance customer outcomes at scale.
  
  
**YOUR DAY TO DAY**

  

* Proactively support customer adoption, expansion, and technical success across proof of value, implementation, and forward-deployed engagements.
* Collaborate with customers, account teams, and partners to design and implement end-to-end solutions that connect data collection, enrichment, activation, and measurement to clear business and AI-driven outcomes
* Lead discovery and solutioning sessions to clarify goals, validate feasibility, assess customer architectures and implementation maturity, and identify technical risks, adoption blockers, optimization opportunities, and new use cases.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts across data, marketing, IT, and emerging AI-focused use cases in a clear and actionable way
* Leverage AI tools and modern workflows (including code assistants, automation, and analytics copilots) to accelerate implementation delivery, improve solution quality, and surface insights more efficiently
* Use SQL, data analysis, visualization, and AI-assisted analytics to validate data quality, identify patterns, and generate scalable, customer-ready insights and recommendations
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across JavaScript tags, APIs, SDKs, integrations, and data pipelines, using both traditional debugging methods and AI-assisted diagnostic approaches to accelerate resolution
* Support proof of value and expansion opportunities by identifying technical requirements, validating solution fit, documenting key decisions and next steps, and applying deep expertise in Tealium’s solutions across customer engagements.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-enabled and modern tooling opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, reduce manual effort, accelerate time-to-value, and optimize delivery outcomes at scale.
Act as a bridge between technical execution and business outcomes, ensuring every implementation is tied to measurable customer value and long-term success  

  

**WHAT YOU BRING TO TEALIUM**

  

* Experience working with Tealium products and solutions is strongly preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in client-facing technical roles such as implementation, solutions consulting, technical support, or customer-facing engineering within a SaaS, digital technology, martech, or data environment.
* Strong experience in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to tagging, APIs, SDKs, integrations, data discrepancies, and front-end implementations in complex customer environments
* Deep familiarity with digital marketing technologies, tag management, customer data platforms, digital analytics, and data/AI-driven workflows across web, mobile, and connected applications
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered tools and modern workflows (e.g., code assistants, analytics copilots, automation tools) to accelerate debugging, improve solution quality, and increase delivery efficiency
* Proficiency with SQL and data analysis to validate implementations, assess data quality, identify issues, and generate actionable customer insights and recommendations
* Expert in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, JS frameworks, and experience in mobile frameworks or other coding languages.
* Ability to lead customer-facing discussions, manage expectations, navigate escalated issues, and collaborate effectively across internal teams, partners, and customers.
* Continuous learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, especially AI-enabled tooling and modern implementation practice.
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately **20%** to support customer engagements, onsite meetings, and other business needs.

  

WAGE TRANSPARENCY

  

In many U.S. states, employers are required to include a pay range for posted positions. Although this isn't a requirement in every state, communicating transparently is a cornerstone of our operations at Tealium, and we believe in making this information available to all applicants.

  

The U.S. pay range for this full-time position is listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a robust benefits package that includes the following:

* Employees are eligible to receive an annual bonus and stock options.
* Employees and their families are eligible for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
* Employees have the option to enroll in our 401k plan and are eligible to receive contributions for company matching.
* Employees are eligible for flexible paid time-off and extended paid parental leave.

jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry began as a phone system for independent pharmacies and grew, product by product, into the communication and workflow platform those pharmacies run on today. Each addition answered a problem pharmacists told us about: phones that never stop ringing, education that gets thrown away, patients who drift to the chains.

Today, Lumistry serves more than 9,000 pharmacies with technology built for pharmacy. Our solutions help pharmacies engage patients, automate work, improve health literacy, reduce operating costs, and grow their businesses. Now we are using AI to take repetitive work off pharmacy teams so they can spend more time with patients.

**The Opportunity**

You know how much of the day goes to repetitive tasks in the pharmacy management system (PMS), like processing refills and entering e-scripts. Our AI-powered automation does that work for the pharmacy team.

As an Onboarding Technician, you instruct an automation agent on how each pharmacy works. You map out each task step by step, think through every “if this happens, then do that,” build it in our workflow builder, and keep it running smoothly once it goes live. The job sits between two worlds. On one side are pharmacy technicians who know their PMS cold but do not think in terms of automation logic. On the other is an automation that will do exactly what you tell it, in exactly the order you tell it, and will stop when reality does not match what you wrote.

Your job is to turn the first into the second, prove it works, and fix it fast when it breaks.

**What You'll Do**

* Set up new pharmacies on our platform and make sure the device that runs their automation is connected and ready.
* Meet with pharmacy teams, learn how they work in their PMS, and map each task step by step, including the decisions and exceptions along the way.
* Build, test, and update automated workflows in our workflow builder for each PMS we support.
* Work with our engineers on the technical pieces, like how the automation recognizes PMS screens and fields, and confirm everything works in the pharmacy.
* Check automation runs every day, figure out why something stopped or failed, and fix it.
* Update workflows when a PMS releases a new version.
* Help grow a library of proven workflow templates so each new pharmacy goes live faster.
* Escalate issues you cannot solve, with screenshots, the step that failed, and what you have already tried.

**What You Bring**

* Pharmacy experience using a pharmacy management system (PMS).
* Logical, critical thinking. You can break a process into steps, think through every “if this, then that,” and figure out why something works nine times out of 10 but fails on the tenth.
* The ability to interview pharmacy staff about how they work: ask follow-up questions, catch the steps they skip because they are second nature, and confirm what you heard.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write instructions others can follow and can calmly explain an issue to a pharmacy.

**Other Details**

* Business hours across U.S. time zones, with occasional after-hours work for go-lives, PMS updates, and a shared on-call rotation as we grow.
* Occasional travel to pharmacies to set up devices and see workflows firsthand.
* You will be trained on our tools and workflows, and your skills in automation and AI will grow with the product.

**Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $70,000 to $75,000.

### **Benefits**

We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

We've been in business as an agency for over 10 years, and we aim to guide our clients towards their measurable success. Our company operates on not only "fixing", but also into helping our clients understand the mechanics on how we actually bring in sales into their company.

Think of us as mechanics for their revenue engine.

Only, we don't just sell the dream and shiny new parts - we guide our clients through the technical stuff and give the tools to fix the leaky sales funnel.

Tactics and methods in the digital marketing world constantly change, but our client-first results-driven business principles don't.

**Fast + Light** is seeking a detail-oriented and technically sharp **Onboarding & Tracking Specialist with expertise in Google Tag Manager and Tracking Setup**, who can get our new clients set up correctly from day one so our ads team can launch with confidence.

As you work with a team that brings scalable success to some of the top names in health and wellness, fashion and home goods, as well as local businesses, selling products, services, and online courses through various social media platforms and Google advertising, your key responsibilities to fulfill this position are:

* Leading new clients through onboarding: gathering account access, assets and business information, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between contract signing and campaign launch;

* Documenting each client's setup and handing it off cleanly to our media buyers and account managers.

One of our visions as a company is to create a world where businesses-- however big or small, and as long as they have the idea and run with the same passion as ours-- get the chance to grow profitably as they help people through their products and/or services.

As we help them grow, we help their customers get products and/or services that they need, and at the same time contribute creating more jobs as our clients' businesses flourish to growth, scalability, and, above all, profitability. Oh! Also before we forget, this is a **part-time position that can grow into a full-time** position quickly. And, you can fulfill your work at the comfort of your own home or literally anywhere around the world as we follow a **fully remote** working location.

We are a relaxed and friendly team, with a fun and casual relationship with most of our clients, though performance and passion for the craft of online advertising is at the core of everything we do. Order.co is looking for a Director of Onboarding to lead how our new customers change the way they buy, and how fast they get there. Onboarding is the first real experience a customer has with us after signing, and every week between contract close and activation is spend that hasn’t moved to Order.co yet. As we grow across our core, partner, and enterprise channels, we need a leader who can oversee multiple customer rollouts at once, with a small but mighty team, without letting speed or quality slip.

This is a leadership role with a broad mandate, and it comes as we reshape what onboarding means at Order.co. Getting a customer live is only the start: this role owns changing how the customer buys. You and your team will move each customer forward by setting milestones with their leadership, driving user change management, rolling out and training across their locations, and ushering them through to fully ramped spend. You will partner closely with a dedicated setup team to ensure the customer experiences one seamless setup. You will own the setup & onboarding strategy and delivery across all three channels and lead a diverse team including individual contributors, team leads, and future people managers. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will set the standard for what onboarding looks like at Order.co.

**What you’ll do**

* **Lead and develop the team.** Coach team members and leaders, establish clear responsibilities and career paths, and allocate projects based on capacity, complexity, and individual strengths.

* **Make adoption stick.** Build training and communication programs for admins, approvers, and requesters across hundreds of locations. Help customers transition purchasing from legacy channels to Order.co and measure success through sustained usage.
* **Own onboarding performance.** Track and improve time to activation against tier-specific SLAs, the share of booked spend reached within four months, location and user adoption, and CSAT.
* **Create seamless transitions.** Establish clear handoffs from Sales and Partnerships, coordinate configuration delivery with Operations, and transition customers to Customer Success once they meet defined onboarding exit criteria.

* **Resolve complex projects.** Serve as the escalation point for at-risk implementations, particularly enterprise deployments, and step in directly when needed.
* **Improve how we work.** Turn customer and team insights into process improvements and Product priorities. Use AI and automation to reduce manual work, and carry improvements through rollout, adoption, and standardization.

**What we’re looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in implementation, customer success, or professional services in SaaS, eCommerce, or B2B, including 3+ years leading teams. Experience managing team leads or managers is a strong plus.
* Experience overseeing multiple concurrent implementations, from high-velocity SMB onboarding to complex enterprise and partner-led deployments.
* A track record of driving adoption across distributed, multi-location businesses through rollout planning, role-based training, and change management.
* The credibility to engage customer executives, hold stakeholders accountable, and influence cross-functional partners you don’t directly manage.
* Experience using data to improve delivery speed, time to value, adoption, and customer satisfaction while supporting a strong team culture.
* A builder’s mindset, with experience creating scalable processes, playbooks, and documentation and guiding teams through change.
* Hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve onboarding, or a clear perspective on where they can reduce manual work.

* Experience in procurement, purchase-to-pay, or supply chain, and familiarity with tools such as Asana, are a plus.

* The opportunity to grow within the overall Customer Success organization

* The opportunity to develop and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team

**Enterprise Implementation Specialist**

**Location:** Remote (East Coast, US.)
  
**Reports to:** Director, Customer Services

**About Crossbeam**

Most go-to-market teams are still running playbooks built for a different era. More cold outreach. More ads. More noise. Crossbeam was built on a different idea: the fastest path to revenue is often through the companies already connected to your customers.

Crossbeam is the platform that makes that possible. Companies use Crossbeam to securely compare CRM data with partners, revealing shared customers, overlapping prospects, and warm paths into deals. We’re defining the category of ecosystem-led growth and giving revenue teams a fundamentally better signal for how to prioritize accounts, collaborate with partners, and win deals faster.

**About the role:**

As an Implementation Specialist on our Enterprise team, you will own the implementation journey for our largest customers (3,500+ employees), from contract close to the day their core use cases are live, and you will stay their technical advisor for the length of their contract. You will work hand in hand with Account Success Managers (ASMs), Account Executives, and our Business Development team to turn a signed contract into a long-term partnership.

**What you'll do:**

Your work is organized around 5 pillars.

* Pre-kickoff & Scoping:

* Join internal handover calls with Account Executives before (or right at) contract close, so customers never feel like discovery is starting over
* Run a client readiness review and a data governance checklist upfront: CRM setup, integration user, SSO, security requirements, internal resources and key deadlines
* Co-lead the kickoff with the ASM: present the implementation plan, timeline, and ownership

* Use-Case-First Implementation & Project Management:

* Partner with the ASM to run a strategy session that aligns on the customer's top use cases, KPIs, and priority partners, then build the implementation plan around them (not around a feature checklist)
* Run weekly working sessions with the customer's RevOps, Partnerships, and IT stakeholders, and deliver a technical go-live within a 90-day target
* Lead the technical rollout across three phases:

  + In-app and CRM setup: sandbox testing (Salesforce, HubSpot), data sources, populations, sharing settings, SSO, and user management
  + Operationalizing partner data: account mapping, report notifications, and integrations with the customer's tech stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, Slack, Copilot, Clay, Snowflake, Gong, MCP and more)
  + Ecosystem growth: partner activation alongside our Business Development team
* Document progress, risks, and decisions in our customer success platform, and flag onboarding risk early so you can act on it together with the ASM

* Enablement & Partner Workshops:

* Scope and deliver customized enablement sessions for admins, partnership teams, sales teams, and leadership
* Run partner workshops that help customers and their partners build collaborative routines using Crossbeam reports, shared lists, and notifications
* Teach customers to be self-sufficient with our Help Center and Academy, and set expectations on how to engage Support and their ASM going forward

* Strategic Advisory & Revenue Impact:

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to admins and executive sponsors, bringing a consultative perspective on how to get more value from their ecosystem
* Hand off to the ASM with a clear picture of what's live, what's next, and where the opportunities are
* Run post-implementation account checks to catch integration issues, seat gaps, and adoption risks before they become churn risks
* Spot expansion signals and scope Professional Services engagements (custom configurations, technical rework, extra enablement or workshops) when needs go beyond standard scope

* Technical Escalation & Continuous Improvement:

* Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues on your Enterprise accounts, working with Support, Product, and Engineering to troubleshoot and resolve them
* Share product feedback from the field to influence our roadmap
* Help build and refine our Enterprise implementation processes, templates, and AI-powered workflows, and share best practices with the team

**What you'll need:**

* 2+ years in implementation or onboarding at a B2B SaaS company
* 1+ year in a customer-facing role
* Experience running technical implementations end to end, with strong project management
* Hands-on experience configuring a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot) and its integrations
* A consultative, solution-oriented mindset
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication

**It’s a bonus if you have:**

* Experience working with Enterprise customers (3,500+ employees)
* Microsoft Dynamics experience
* Familiarity with MCP and AI tooling

**You'll do great if you:**

* Lead with outcomes, not features. You ask "what is this customer trying to achieve?" before deciding what to configure
* Are comfortable in the room with both a Salesforce admin and a VP of Partnerships, and adjust your message to each
* Protect quality. You set realistic expectations and push back (kindly and clearly) when a timeline or scope puts the customer at risk
* See every implementation call as a chance to drive adoption, reduce risk, and surface the next opportunity
* Take ownership without waiting for permission, and keep multi-stakeholder projects moving when priorities shift
* Dig until you understand the real problem, not just the surface request
* Use AI to synthesize information, prep sessions, and move faster, while knowing when a human touch matters most
* Like building the playbook as much as running it. Our Enterprise motion is evolving, and your input will shape it

**You'll get:**

* Collaborative teammates and a culture built on trust and accountability
* Competitive compensation and equity
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your family
* Remote-flexible with access to co-working spaces in your area
* Learning, wellness, and WFH stipends
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* ...and more!

Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**EAS-IV Trainer/Training Specialist**

**Description:**

Designs and delivers end-user and administrator training, train-the-trainer sessions and materials (user guides, FAQs, distance learning); supports material development, logistics and delivery.

* Federal program managers, and administrative users across diverse operational branches
* System administrators and technical operations personnel responsible for ongoing platform support
* Super-users and designated organizational trainers participating in train-the-trainer (T3) programs
* Cross-functional program and transition team personnel across enterprise rollout phases
* Part-Time position for 23 hours/week.
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Create a training plan and responsible for all deliverables.
* Design, author, and maintain comprehensive training collateral, including instructor guides, student workbooks, lesson plans, and quick-reference guides (QRGs).
* Conduct interactive virtual instructor-led training (vILT), webinars, and structured train-the-trainer (T3) workshops.
* Formulate assessment instruments, practical scenario-based exercises, and post-course evaluations to measure training effectiveness and knowledge retention.
* Create and update engaging multimedia instructional modules and digital job aids using modern eLearning authoring tools.
* Capture evolving training requirements through direct engagement with functional stakeholders, technical SMEs, and systems developers.
* Manage training scheduling, participant registration, logistics coordination, and attendance tracking records.
* Work closely with program quality assurance and continual service improvement personnel to ensure all training collateral meets or exceeds quality benchmarks.
* Provide strategic input to shape overall workforce enablement, distance learning, and change enablement strategies across the enterprise rollout.

**Skills:**

* Competency in Microsoft Office products: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Proven experience training a diverse group of topics including both technical and operational
* Strong customer service and communications skills
* Ability to develop professional training content
* Strong English skills – both written and spoken
* Ability to create training content using multi-media tools such as Captivate and Adobe Creative cloud
* Strong knowledge of the Military Health Environment

##### **Qualifications**

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Human Resource Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of dedicated instructional design and training delivery experience (Trainer - Senior level).
* 5+ years of training coordination, instructional support, and logistics management experience (Training Specialist - Journeyman level).
* Proven track record implementing distance-learning, virtual classroom, and train-the-trainer (T3) models.
* Familiarity with knowledge management and ticketing platforms (such as ServiceNow or ITIL practices) a plus.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 Non-Critical Sensitive (Public Trust) determination.
* US Citizenship required.
* Dedicated remote work environment with adherence to core hours (0800 to 1700 Eastern) utilizing Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE) over VPN; flexibility to support occasional off-hours training sessions as required.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.
